text: Nghe An province's exports hit $5.77 billion in 10M
Central Nghe An province recorded more than $5.77 billion in exports in the first 10 months of 2026, up 52.73 per cent year-on-year and 15.45 per cent above its full-year target.
Exports in October alone were estimated at over $590 million.
In the ten-month period, electronic equipment and components remained the province's leading export category, generating approximately $3.32 billion, or 57.5 per cent of total export value.
Other significant contributors included steel sheets, alloy aluminium, textiles and garments, footwear, automotive components, machinery and equipment.
Several agricultural products also recorded solid growth, including cassava and cassava-based products, rice, tea and seafood.
Local businesses continued to serve established export markets such as the United States, China, South Korea, Japan and ASEAN countries, while also seeking opportunities to expand into new markets.
